name: Barbell Seated Calf Raise
steps: Sit near the edge of a bench with feet planted flat and balance a barbell across your lower thighs just above your knees.
Hold the bar steady with both hands and keep your shins roughly vertical.
Drive through the balls of both feet to lift your heels as high as possible, squeezing your calves firmly.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor without bouncing into the next repetition.
tips: Keep the barbell back on your thighs well clear of your kneecaps, using a folded towel for padding if needed.
Rise evenly across both forefeet so your ankles do not roll outward.
